many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

import os,glob,re,collections, copy, json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    path = d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl'
    txt=open(path).read().replace('\\n','\n')
    # The compacted t contains many JSON lines; search only within non-JSON lines
    out={}
    for line in txt.split('\n'):
        if not line.strip() or line.strip().startswith('{"type') or line.strip().startswith('<harness_state'):
            continue
        m=re.match(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n', line)
        if not m: continue
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rest=[r.strip() for r in line[m.end():].split('\n')][:h]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rest):
            out[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rest]
    return out

G=load()
print(sorted(G.keys()))
for k,v in sorted(G.items()):
    print(k, len(v), 'x', len(v[0]))

import os,glob,re,collections, copy, json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    path = d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl'
    txt=open(path).read().replace('\\n','\n')
    out={}
    for line in txt.split('\n'):
        if not line.strip() or 'Demo pair' not in line and 'Test input' not in line: continue
        m=re.match(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n', line)
        if not m: continue
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rest=[r.strip() for r in line[m.end():].split('\n')][:h]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rest):
            out[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rest]
    return out

G=load()
print(sorted(G.keys()))
for k,v in sorted(G.items()): print(k, len(v), 'x', len(v[0]))
